goal: Validate the signed 12-to-24-bit hierarchical fold architecture at 752 MHz with exactly-once registered-SRAM consumption and full 16-bit k_dim support.

bugs_found: The accumulator architecture is no longer the critical path. A redundant issued<k_dim_q comparison was synthesized into a 15-stage control cone from issued[0] to both external request outputs, causing two setup violations.
learnings: The hierarchical fold moved the bottleneck from arithmetic to request control. Remove the redundant progress comparator from the S_REQ output decode before Y2. The next clean data path has about 30 ps slack at 752 MHz, implying about 774 MHz headroom under the same 20% I/O budget; choose 760 MHz for Y2 after the control repair.
